program_terms.notes: At least one trip to Spain during the authorised period of residence. The requirement is not in the art. 66 rewritten by Ley 25/2015 (in force 30 Jul 2015).

program_terms.applies_to: application for the residence authorisation after the investor visa expires
program_terms.quote: hallarse dentro del plazo de los noventa días naturales posteriores a la caducidad de éste
program_terms.notes: The residence authorisation may be requested while the visa is valid or within 90 calendar days after it expires. Kept by Ley 25/2015 (art. 66.2).

program_terms.applies_to: financial routes: certificates proving the investment was maintained
program_terms.quote: El certificado deberá estar fechado dentro de los 30 días anteriores a la presentación de la solicitud.
program_terms.notes: Certificates (notary, bank or Banco de España) proving the financial investment was kept must be dated within 30 days before the authorisation application. Kept by Ley 25/2015.

program_terms.applies_to: real-estate route: Land Registry ownership certificate
program_terms.quote: debe estar fechado dentro de los 90 días anteriores a la presentación de la solicitud
program_terms.notes: Land Registry certificate proving ownership of property worth the minimum must be dated within 90 days before the authorisation application. Kept by Ley 25/2015 (art. 66.2 b)).

program_terms.applies_to: visa and residence-authorisation applicants (all Ley 14/2013 categories)
program_terms.quote: b) Ser mayor de 18 años.
program_terms.notes: General requirement for all Ley 14/2013 visas and authorisations; still in the consolidated text (2025).

program_terms.applies_to: visa and residence-authorisation applicants
program_terms.quote: Carecer de antecedentes penales en España y en los países donde haya residido durante los últimos cinco años
program_terms.notes: No criminal record in Spain or countries of residence in the last five years. Ley 28/2022 reduced this to two years plus a sworn declaration covering five years (from 23 Dec 2022).

program_terms.applies_to: children of the investor who may apply as family members (or adult children unable to provide for themselves for health reasons)
program_terms.quote: El cónyuge y los hijos menores de 18 años, o mayores de edad que no sean
program_terms.notes: Spouse and children under 18 (or older children who cannot support themselves for health reasons). Ley 25/2015 widened family members to partners, adult dependent children and dependent ascendants.

program_terms.applies_to: uniform (Schengen stay) visa issued under the Ley 14/2013 mobility section
program_terms.quote: El periodo de validez no será superior a cinco años.
program_terms.notes: Investors could request a stay visa or a residence visa (art. 63.1); the uniform visa may be single, double or multiple entry, validity up to five years.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal of investor visas and authorisations
program_terms.quote: la renovación de la residencia podrá efectuarse aún existiendo ausencias superiores a seis meses al año en el caso de visados de residencia y autorizaciones para inversores extranjeros
program_terms.notes: Not a minimum: investor residence may be renewed even with absences of more than six months a year (continuity of residence still needed for long-term residence or citizenship). Still in the consolidated text (2025).

program_terms.applies_to: investment made through a legal person
program_terms.quote: cuando la inversión la lleve a cabo una persona jurídica, domiciliada en un territorio que no tenga la consideración de paraíso fiscal
program_terms.notes: Investment through a company counts if the company is not domiciled in a tax haven and the applicant holds, directly or indirectly, the majority of voting rights and can appoint or remove the majority of the board. Restated by Ley 25/2015.

program_terms.applies_to: financial routes (public debt, shares, funds, bank deposits)
program_terms.location: p. 64531 (BOE), disposición final undécima, Tres (art. 64 a))
program_terms.quote: en un periodo no superior a un año a la presentación de la solicitud
program_terms.notes: Extended from 60 days (2013 text).

program_terms.applies_to: real-estate pre-contract with a guaranteed deposit (visa)
program_terms.location: p. 64532 (BOE), disposición final undécima, Tres (art. 64 b))
program_terms.quote: recibirá un visado de residencia para inversores de duración máxima de 6 meses
program_terms.notes: Where the purchase is not yet formalised but there is a pre-contract with guarantee and a blocked bank deposit covering the price, taxes and charges, a visa of at most 6 months is issued; after the purchase, a one-year visa or an authorisation may be requested.

program_terms.applies_to: real-estate pre-contract with a guaranteed deposit (residence authorisation, applicant already in Spain)
program_terms.quote: recibirá una autorización de residencia para inversores de duración máxima de 6 meses
program_terms.notes: Same pre-contract rule for applicants legally in Spain who apply directly for the authorisation.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal of investor residence authorisation
program_terms.quote: podrán solicitar la renovación de la autorización de residencia por periodos sucesivos de cinco años
program_terms.notes: Successive five-year renewals while the conditions are maintained (was two years). The general art. 76 still says two years "sin perjuicio de lo establecido en el artículo 67.2".

program_terms.applies_to: initial investor residence authorisation
program_terms.quote: La autorización inicial de residencia para inversores tendrá una duración de dos años
program_terms.notes: Restates two years (except the 6-month pre-contract authorisation). Raised to three years by Ley 28/2022.

program_terms.applies_to: investment by spouses under a community-property regime
program_terms.quote: y la cuantía no asciende, al menos, al doble de los umbrales previstos en las letras a) y b) del apartado 2
program_terms.notes: If a married couple invests jointly and the amount is less than double the financial or real-estate threshold, the investment counts for one spouse only; the other may apply as a family member. Same rule in art. 66.3 for authorisations.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal application filed after the previous authorisation expired
program_terms.quote: en los noventa días posteriores a la finalización de la anterior autorización
program_terms.notes: A renewal filed within 90 days after expiry still extends the authorisation until decided, without prejudice to a sanction procedure.

program_terms.applies_to: any change affecting admission conditions during residence
program_terms.location: p. 64538 (BOE), disposición final undécima, Doce (disposición adicional séptima.2)
program_terms.quote: deberá ser comunicada por el interesado a la Unidad de Grandes Empresas y Colectivos Estratégicos en el plazo de 30 días
program_terms.notes: Added by Ley 25/2015 (the 2013 disposición adicional séptima had no deadline).

program_terms.applies_to: family members who may apply with or after the investor
program_terms.quote: hayan constituido por sí mismos una unidad familiar y los ascendientes a cargo
program_terms.notes: Spouse or partner in an analogous relationship, minor children, adult children economically dependent who have not formed their own family unit, and dependent ascendants (widened from spouse and children under 18 or unable to support themselves).

program_terms.applies_to: initial investor residence authorisation
program_terms.quote: La autorización inicial de residencia para inversores tendrá una duración de tres años
program_terms.notes: Raised from two to three years (except the 6-month pre-contract authorisation). In force the day after publication (BOE 22 Dec 2022).

program_terms.applies_to: visa and residence-authorisation applicants (all Ley 14/2013 categories)
program_terms.location: p. 179048 (BOE), disposición final quinta, Dos (art. 62.3 c))
program_terms.quote: residido durante los dos últimos años, por delitos previstos en el ordenamiento jurídico español
program_terms.notes: No criminal record in Spain or countries of residence in the last two years (was five), plus a sworn declaration of no criminal record in the last five years.

program_terms.applies_to: all Ley 14/2013 visas and residence authorisations
program_terms.quote: Se revocarán, denegarán o no renovarán las autorizaciones de residencia y los visados previstos en esta sección cuando la persona extranjera interesada pueda
program_terms.notes: Visas and authorisations are refused, revoked or not renewed where the person may threaten public order, public or national security or public health, based on a police, CNI or National Security Department report. Present in the consolidated text (last modified 9 Apr 2025); the amending law and its date are not given in this copy, so valid_from is blank and valid_to is the date of the text.

events.title: Transitional rules after the end of Spain's investor visas
events.description: Ley Orgánica 1/2025 adds two transitional provisions to Ley 14/2013: investors and family members who applied before 3 April 2025 may still receive the visa or authorisation under the rules in force when they applied; visas and authorisations valid on that date keep their validity, and renewals are decided under the rules in force when the initial authorisation was granted.
events.location: p. 261 (BOE p. 1056), disposición final vigesimoprimera, Dos and Tres
events.quote: podrán recibir el visado o autorización correspondiente conforme a la normativa vigente en la fecha de presentación de la solicitud

new_indicators.name: Share of programme investment by nationality or region
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of the total qualifying investment made under a residence- or citizenship-by-investment programme in a period that came from investors of one nationality, or went into one region or province, as printed by the source. Never calculated by us. Use breakdown nationality= or region= (with route= when the base is one route). Companion to rbi_investment_total; shares by asset class or route stay in rbi_investment_share.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-esp1 for the Spanish 2019 parliamentary answer (184/41377, real-estate investment by nationality) and the 2015 MEYSS report (Cuadros 4 and 6; province shares on p. 53-54).

new_indicators.name: Share of programme grants by region of the investment
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of a programme's grants (visas, permits or citizenships) in a period whose qualifying investment is located in a given region or province, as printed by the source. Never calculated by us. Use breakdown region= (ISO 3166-2 code where possible) and route=.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-esp1 for Spanish real-estate golden visas by province (184/41377 table of destinations; MEYSS 2015 Cuadro 5; 2024 government releases: six provinces 90%). Nationality shares stay in applicant_nationality_share.

ledger.contains: Full text of Ley 14/2013 (BOE 28 Sep 2013, 96 pp.): support for entrepreneurs, tax and internationalisation measures (out of scope), and Title V Section 2 'Movilidad internacional' (arts. 61-76 and additional provisions). In scope: investor visa and residence authorisation (arts. 61-67): route thresholds (5 existing terms) and launch event (existing); now added the other rules as terms (visa validity, initial and renewal durations, 60-day investment window, 5-year public-debt holding, one-trip presence rule, 90-day visa grace period, certificate dating (30/90 days), minimum age 18, criminal-record look-back 5 years, family members (children under 18), stay-visa validity up to 5 years, absences over six months tolerated at renewal (DA 6.ª), investment through a company) and statutory deadlines as processing_time_goal_days (visa 10 working days, authorisation 20 days, police check 7 days). Fees are left to a ministerial order (DF 10.ª.4; no amount printed); DF 11.ª requires an annual report to the Council of Ministers (no numbers). Entrepreneur, highly-qualified, researcher and intra-company rules are out of scope.

BOE consolidated text of Ley 14/2013, last modified 9 Apr 2025 (86 pp.): arts. 63-67 (investors) 'sin contenido'; transitional provisions 1 and 2 added by LO 1/2025 (pending applications and renewals); general requirements art. 62 as amended (criminal record two years plus five-year declaration; wider family; new art. 62.7 security-based refusal/revocation); arts. 75-76 as amended; DA 6.ª (absences), DA 7.ª (30-day change notification), DA 19.ª (fee set by ministerial order, no amount). Rules are recorded from the dated amending laws (Ley 25/2015, Ley 28/2022, LO 1/2025) rather than duplicated from this undated snapshot; added here only art. 62.7 (security revocation), whose amending law is not named in this copy. The rest of the law (entrepreneurs, tax, other mobility categories incl. teleworkers) is out of scope.

Ley 25/2015 (BOE 29 Jul 2015; second-chance mechanism and other measures, 65 pp.). In scope only disposición final undécima, which rewrites arts. 62.4, 63-67, 76 and DA 7.ª of Ley 14/2013. Existing: funds and shares terms, rule-change event. Added terms: one-year investment window, 6-month pre-contract visa and authorisation, five-year renewals, initial authorisation two years restated, double threshold for married couples, 90-day late renewal grace, 30-day change notification, wider family eligibility. The 20-day decision deadline is restated unchanged (recorded from the 2013 law). Rest of the law (insolvency, social security, other mobility categories) out of scope.

Ley 28/2022 on start-ups (BOE 22 Dec 2022, 44 pp.). In scope: disposición final quinta amending Ley 14/2013: initial investor authorisation three years (event existing; term added) and criminal-record look-back cut to two years plus a five-year sworn declaration (term added). Other changes concern entrepreneurs, highly-qualified workers, researchers, intra-company transfers, the new digital-nomad (teleworker) visa and Social Security registration with a passport: out of scope. Note: the art. 67.1 text sits on BOE p. 179048 (existing event says p. 179049).

Ley Orgánica 1/2025 on the efficiency of the justice system (BOE 3 Jan 2025, 272 pp.). In scope only disposición final vigesimoprimera (empties arts. 63-67 of Ley 14/2013; adds transitional provisions on pending applications and renewals) and disposición final trigésima octava (in force three months after publication). Existing closure event; added one rule_change event for the transitional provisions. Everything else (courts, procedure, mediation) is out of scope; no numbers about the programme.
